overall_goal: Fry the chicken cheese balls in oil, turning them for even cooking, and remove them when golden.

goals.description: Turn the chicken cheese balls in the oil to ensure even frying.
goals.rationale: The person uses a skimmer to rotate the frying chicken cheese balls in the hot oil.

goals.description: Remove the fried chicken cheese balls from the oil and set them aside.
goals.rationale: The person uses the skimmer to extract the fully cooked chicken cheese balls from the pan and transfers them to a bowl.

goals.description: Add another chicken cheese ball to the oil and fry it.
goals.rationale: The person drops a new chicken cheese ball into the hot oil and turns it with the skimmer to cook.
